query.title: Company/business name or registration number
query.description: A company/business name (or partial name -- matches on individual words) or COJ registration number (e.g. 61230, or 7874/2015 for a registered business name). Numbers match as a substring, so a short number can return many entities -- use the full registration number for a precise lookup.

queries.title: Company/business names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return per search query. The register itself returns at most 200 matches for any single search.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent searches
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel. Keep this low (1-2) -- the register applies a temporary block to bursts of rapid requests (it recovers on its own after roughly a minute, and the actor retries automatically, but a high value here makes that more likely to happen and slows the overall run down).

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between queries (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: Pause inserted before each additional query starts, as a courtesy to the register's own stated crawl delay. The register's robots.txt asks for 120 seconds between requests; the default here is a shorter, still-respectful pace found to work reliably during testing. Raise it to 120 for strict compliance if running a very large batch.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
